title: The Uniform of the Cape Route
author: Lior Eriksen
blurb: Ansel Underhill, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
